subject: Re: Post-call recap — model fit & follow-ups / regression after v2.1 update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:00:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call recap: recommended model candidates + next steps

Hi Priya — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

1) Key asks you mentioned:
- High precision on entity extraction for financial docs (low false positives)
- Consistent summarization across long documents (>8k tokens)
- Enterprise SLAs around latency and model pinning for regulated workflows

2) Recommended starting models (based on our evals):
- redwood-phi-7B-q4 (good precision / cost tradeoff)
- redwood-compat-13B (best recall on your extraction test set)
- redwood-legacy-3.5 (stable baseline we can pin)

3) Attached: prompt-set-acme-v1.txt (your canonical prompt/test cases) and the benchmark summary I ran quickly against your sample set: acme-benchmark-summary-20260610.pdf. Also linking the full benchmark workspace: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/acme/model-benchmarks/20260610

Next steps:
- You: confirm which subset of prompts we should prioritize for the deep eval (suggest 10-15 core prompts).
- Me/Dev: spin a dedicated eval run with the three candidates above, return a short diff report and recommended pinning strategy by EOD tomorrow (Thu).
- Optional: if you want immediate stability we can pin production traffic to redwood-legacy-3.5 while we run the evals.

Happy to hop on a 15m follow-up if helpful.

Cheers,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs:
- prompt-set-acme-v1.txt (text file, 15 prompts)
- acme-benchmark-summary-20260610.pdf (summary PDF)

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Sharma <rahul@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 17:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: recommended model candidates + next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciate the suggested candidates. One urgent note: we pushed a scheduled model update this morning (Redwood model tag v2.1) for our sandbox traffic and are seeing clear quality regressions on our critical extraction prompts - higher false positives and degraded summary fidelity. I've attached the quick diff report we generated on our side (regression-diff-report-v2.1.pdf).

Can you team look into this ASAP? If v2.1 is rolling out to any production routes, we'd like to request an immediate pin back to the previous stable tag for now (we can take the hit on throughput while we validate). We're in the middle of a compliance audit and can't tolerate this variance.

Priya Kapoor
Head of Data Products | Acme AI
priya.kapoor@acme.ai

Attachment stubs:
- regression-diff-report-v2.1.pdf (PDF with example outputs and diff tables)

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 14:00, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Priya — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: ...

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 01:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: recommended model candidates + next steps

Hi Priya — Dev on infra. Thanks for the quick diff - I pulled the sample set. Short answers and proposed immediate action: 

- Root cause hypothesis: a kernel selection/optimizer change in the v2.1 runtime path caused subtle tokenization/decoding differences for this class of prompts; appears to impact extraction thresholds.
- Immediate mitigations we can do right away:
  1) Pin the affected route to model tag redwood-legacy-3.5 (what we call a stable baseline) - I can apply that within the hour for any routes you specify.
  2) Create a canary rollback of the tag to v2.0 for broader traffic if you prefer a wider revert.
  3) Start a focused eval run against your prompt-set-acme-v1.txt and the diff report to produce a more formal regression report and PR for our runtime team.

If you confirm route names (or say "all production routes"), I will pin immediately and follow up with the rollback plan and timeframe. I will also open a ticket with runtime ops and include the diff you attached.

- Dev
Dev Patel | Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 17:12, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciate the suggested candidates. One urgent note: ...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 03:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: recommended model candidates + next steps

Thanks for raising this, Priya. From a product/account perspective - I support the immediate pin to redwood-legacy-3.5 while we investigate. Two asks while we stabilize: 

1) Priya - can you confirm you want us to pin "all production routes" or list specific route IDs? Pinning all will force extra capacity and may impact latency slightly.
2) Marissa/Dev - please also capture the baseline eval artifacts (the run ID, seed prompts, and model tags) and share the formal regression report by EOD Thursday so Acme can include it in their compliance notes.

I'll coordinate with CS to offer a temporary credit if this caused material impact; Marissa, please keep pricing discussions separate until we quantify.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Product, Platform
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: recommended model candidates + next steps

Thanks - please pin all production routes to redwood-legacy-3.5 immediately. We accept the latency/throughput tradeoff for now. Also confirm when the rollback/canary will be scheduled and share the formal regression report and the run artifacts (benchmarks, seed prompts, run id). Once we have that, we'll decide on next steps for upgrade testing.

Priya Kapoor | Head of Data Products, Acme AI
priya.kapoor@acme.ai
